title: Jack Rabbit Rachael Rabbit Blueberry, Citrus and Pineapple E-Liquid Shortfill 100ml
description: Rachael Rabbit’s Blueberry, Citrus and Pineapple is an exquisite combination of fruit flavours, blending the distinctly delicious characteristics of forest and tropical fruits in a spellbinding dance of flavours. The rich, deep sweetness of blueberries meets the sharp, zesty edge of citrus, rounded off with the unmistakably sunny tang of exotic pineapple. A smooth layer of ice envelops these flavours, providing a refreshing finish to this complex and endlessly satisfying fruity vape. Contained in a 120ml shortfill bottle, this product comes with 100ml of e-liquid, leaving space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots. Adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nicotine shots will mix into 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, allowing you to customize your vaping experience. With a 70VG/30PG ratio, it's perfectly suited for sub-ohm vaping, delivering rich flavour and dense vapour production on high-powered pod kits, mods, and tanks. Shortfills like Rachael Rabbit's offer a cost-effective solution for vapers, combining savings with complete control over nicotine strength. These e-liquids are particularly suited for advanced sub-ohm kits, accommodating the faster consumption rates of high-powered devices. Crafted in the UK, Rachael Rabbit focuses on intricate fruit medleys, ensuring no blend is less than exceptional. Each e-liquid features a trio of distinct notes, creating layered blends that promise an authentically fruity vape experience.
